articles.title: [HIGH CVE] CVE-2026-112207 in Various Systems
articles.plain_summary: The Download Monitor WordPress plugin before 5.3.4 does not properly validate that a clicked link belongs to the site before fetching it client-side and rendering part of the response in the page, which allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the browser of any user who is tricked into clicking a crafted link.

articles.title: [MEDIUM CVE] CVE-2026-113489 in Various Systems
articles.plain_summary: The GeoDirectory WordPress plugin before 2.8.194 does not verify that a referenced attachment belongs to the listing being saved, allowing users with Subscriber-level access and above to modify the title, caption, moderation status and featured flag of images belonging to other users' listings, and to claim another user's image as their own featured image.

related.title: [MEDIUM CVE] CVE-2026-113490 in Various Systems

articles.title: [MEDIUM CVE] CVE-2026-113490 in Various Systems
articles.plain_summary: The GeoDirectory WordPress plugin before 2.8.194 does not perform any status or ownership check when rendering a listing's map-popup through one of its single-item REST routes, allowing unauthenticated users to read the title, permalink and card fields of non-public (draft, pending, private and trashed) listings by supplying the listing ID.

related.title: [MEDIUM CVE] CVE-2026-113489 in Various Systems
[MEDIUM CVE] CVE-2026-113491 in Various Systems

articles.title: [MEDIUM CVE] CVE-2026-113491 in Various Systems
articles.plain_summary: The GeoDirectory WordPress plugin before 2.8.194 does not validate a user-supplied image URL before using it as a local file path when saving a front-end listing, allowing users with Subscriber-level access and above to read files from outside the web root and to delete files on the server, limited to file names that carry an allowed media extension.

related.title: [MEDIUM CVE] CVE-2026-113489 in Various Systems

articles.title: [MEDIUM CVE] CVE-2026-107887 in Various Systems
articles.plain_summary: The Advanced Twenty Seventeen WordPress plugin through 1.3.1 does not perform any capability or nonce check on the action that creates and activates its bundled child , allowing any authenticated user such as a subscriber to switch the site's active site-wide, and allowing the same action to be triggered against any logged-in user including an administrator via CSRF.

articles.title: [MEDIUM CVE] CVE-2026-107907 in Various Systems
articles.plain_summary: The MAS Videos WordPress plugin through 1.3.4 does not perform any capability or ownership check when handling its front-end video and playlist deletion requests, and the nonce it verifies is tied only to a static action rather than to the targeted object, allowing any authenticated user with a minimal role to permanently delete arbitrary posts, pages, attachments and other content belonging to other users.

articles.title: [MEDIUM CVE] CVE-2026-105199 in Various Systems
articles.plain_summary: The Pixel Tag Manager for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 2.2.3 does not perform a capability check in one of its AJAX actions, and exposes the nonce protecting it to any user able to access the admin dashboard, allowing users with a role as low as Contributor to overwrite the Pixel Tag Manager for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 2.2.3's tracking configuration and have arbitrary JavaScript executed in the browsers of all visitors, including administrators.
